title: 经济系统（AccountManeger）
description: Account Manager is a core economic system module specifically designed for Minecraft servers.
body:
**Account Manager** is a core module for Minecraft servers designed to provide an economic system. It offers a stable and user-friendly economic framework, allowing other functional modules (such as shops, quests, and territories) to interact with this economic system through API interfaces, thus achieving unified currency transactions and management.

# Key Features
Complete Economic System‌: Supports player accounts, transfers, deposits, withdrawals, and more.
**API Interface‌**: Provides a full API for developers of other modules.

**Event System‌**: Allows listening to events such as transactions and balance changes.

**Administrator Tools‌**: Offers comprehensive management commands and permission controls.

**Data Persistence‌**: Supports data storage in JSON/NBT formats.

**Highly Configurable‌**: Currency name, symbol, initial balance, and other settings are fully customizable.

## Account System

**Automatic Account Creation‌**: Accounts are automatically created for players when they first join the server.

**Player Accounts‌**: Each player has an individual account storing balance and transaction history.

**Global Account‌**: A server-level bank account used for taxes, fees, and other purposes.

**Transaction History‌**: Records details of every transaction for auditing purposes.

## Currency Operations

**Deposit/Withdrawal‌**: Users can deposit or withdraw money from their accounts.

**Transfer‌**: Players can transfer money to one another.

**Balance Inquiry‌**: Real-time balance checks for accounts.

**Balance Limits‌**: Configurable minimum/maximum balances, with options to allow negative balances.

## Management Functions

**Balance Management‌**: Administrators can set, increase, or decrease player balances.

**Wealth Leaderboard‌**: View the wealthiest players on the server.

**Data Backup‌**: Automatically saves account data to prevent loss during server restarts.

**Configuration Reload‌**: Supports hot-reloading of configuration files.
